prompts: Use case: precise-object-edit. Refine the attached B logo for XR ScienceTeacher. Preserve its overall identity: two opposing spatial corner brackets, navy left and teal right, clean open frame. The user wants more refinement and clearer meaning. Replace the ambiguous solid central diamond with a crisp small ISOMETRIC CUBE: exactly three visible faces, clear top diamond, left and right quadrilateral faces, and a fine central vertical edge. Use restrained contrasting flat navy/teal fill or clear outline so the cube reads immediately as a 3D scientific object. Add just two thin short horizontal alignment lines from the cube toward the inside of the opposing brackets, and one tiny registration tick below the cube, expressing a virtual object located within a see-through AR window. Maintain clear negative space around the cube. Refine corner geometry and consistent stroke weights; bracket edges slightly rounded, precision engineered not bulky. Strong balanced silhouette for a professional app logo. Strictly flat vector-like solid ink colors #173344 and #13A3A5; NO gradients, NO texture, NO glow, NO shadow, NO lighting, NO 3D bevel. Fully TRANSPARENT background. No text, no letters, no wordmark, no caption, no watermark, no border, no mockup. One centered logo only. This must stay SIMPLE: do not add dense circuit patterns, an atom, extra orbital rings, or too many detail lines.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Redesign the attached logo to fix its inconsistent visual weights. Retain ONLY the concept of two opposing AR window brackets framing a cube; redraw the whole symbol as a precise MONOLINE LOGO. CRITICAL: every visible stroke has EXACTLY THE SAME thickness, including the outer brackets and ALL cube edges. Outer brackets must NOT be thick filled blocks. Center cube must NOT have filled faces. Use clean uniform rounded line strokes approximately 28 px wide at 1024 px canvas, same thickness everywhere, no tapering and no variable width. Make two large opposing corner brackets forming an open hexagonal/isometric window. In the center place a simple wireframe isometric cube made from nine equal-weight line segments; all three visible faces transparent. Remove all tiny ticks and extraneous dashes. Every join, cap and corner uses the same restrained rounding radius. Cube uses exactly the same line weight as brackets; make the cube sufficiently large, about 42 percent of overall symbol width, so the design is balanced. Crisp mathematically regular isometric angles. Two solid colors only: left bracket and left cube edges navy #173344, right bracket and remaining cube edges teal #13A3A5. No gradients, no shading, no texture, no glow, no shadow. A refined minimalist flat vector-like professional logo with consistent stroke engineering, balanced negative space, recognizable at small size. Centered, fully TRANSPARENT background. No text, letters, border, wordmark, watermark or mockup. One logo.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Refine THIS accepted monoline AR cube logo only. Preserve concept, isometric angles, opposing open brackets, centered wireframe cube, navy/teal palette and transparent background. User asks for thicker strokes and tightly unified positive and negative widths. Increase ALL stroke thicknesses about 28 percent, uniformly, including outer brackets, each cube edge, verticals, diagonals and end caps. ALL solid stroke widths must be IDENTICAL when measured perpendicular to the line. Make the central cube slightly larger and bring the outer brackets slightly closer to it, so the negative channels between the cube and the inner bracket edges are consistently about ONE stroke-width. Carefully balance all major gaps optically, with left/right clearances equal, top/bottom clearances equal, open ends balanced, no arbitrarily wide empty zones. Use a precise modular grid: the same module governs stroke thickness, main negative spaces and corner radius. Keep the overall outer silhouette the same size and centered; thicker lines should reduce wasted interior space. Make the cube perfectly regular, three transparent faces, no filled faces. Strong, compact, polished app-icon identity that reads at 24 px. Solid ink colors only #173344 and #13A3A5, crisp flat vector style, equal weight everywhere, clean joins with restrained consistent rounding. No gradients, no shading, no glow, no blur, no shadow, no texture, no tiny extra details. Fully transparent background. No text, letters, numbers, watermark or mockup. Exactly ONE logo.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Make exactly ONE correction in the CENTER CUBE of this logo. The outer left bracket must remain ENTIRELY navy, and the outer right bracket must remain ENTIRELY teal, exactly as in the input. Do not recolor or modify the brackets. In the center wireframe cube ONLY, change the navy/teal division at the top apex from a rounded overlapping cap into a perfectly straight vertical seam down the cube's centerline. The left half of the cube is solid navy #173344, right half teal #13A3A5. At the top apex the two colors meet cleanly on a vertical line with NO curved overlap. At the center vertical edge, use the same vertical straight centerline split. Preserve all stroke widths, outer contour, positions, shapes, negative spaces, thick uniform monoline style and transparent background exactly. Do not redesign anything. Remove speckles or stray pixels outside the intended strokes, keep all fills flat solid color and all edges crisp. No glow, no gradient, no shading, no texture. Fully transparent background, no text or watermark.
meaning: 外侧两根完整色框代表AR视窗，中央立方体代表可交互的科学实验对象；仅立方体的双色在中轴以竖直线相接。
